title: Bump opum-quest pin to quest-cli v0.7.0
summary: CONDITIONAL, per opum-agent's sequencing call, 2026-09-15: hold this for quest-cli's v0.7.0 publish; only do the v0.6.2 bump if v0.7.0 has NOT landed by the time this is picked up. Two facts, verified separately, not one: npm @opum-ai/quest dist-tags.latest is 0.6.2 (already published, opum-marketplace's pin is still v0.6.0 -- a real, standing two-version gap independent of the 0.7.0 question). quest-cli also has a v0.7.0 tag already (gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/tags confirms it, commit 2d5dd6b4f9) but npm @opum-ai/quest@0.7.0 still 404s as of 2026-09-15 -- publish is gated on quest-cli's own user authorizing the route, mirroring lore's v0.7.0 situation exactly (OMARK-49). Since v0.7.0 supersedes v0.6.2 entirely for what the pin federates, bumping to v0.6.2 now would likely be redundant within the hour if 0.7.0 lands -- two PRs/promotions/verification passes where one would do. Check npm first: if latest is already 0.7.0, skip straight to that (same verify-independently pattern as opum-lore -- resolve the tag chain yourself, don't trust any number in this task or a peer message). If 0.7.0 still hasn't landed after a reasonable wait, do the v0.6.2 bump on its own merits -- a public marketplace federating a two-releases-old plugin is real staleness that shouldn't wait indefinitely on someone else's unrelated release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: npm dist-tags.latest checked first, independently, to decide which of the two bumps (v0.6.2 or v0.7.0) is actually current before doing either.

Whichever version is targeted, the skills/ tree is resolved independently via the GitHub API chain (ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills subtree), not taken from any cached number in this task.
plugin.json at the target tag self-declares the matching version.
marketplace.json ref and federated-pin-baselines.json opum-quest entry moved together in the same change.
Both federated checker scripts and their regression suites pass locally against the new pin before landing.

finalSummary: Bumped opum-quest pin v0.6.0 -> v0.7.0 with the baseline moved in the same commit. npm dist-tags.latest 0.7.0 checked independently (main package plus darwin-arm64, linux-x64, win32-x64), so the v0.6.2 arm was skipped. Tag chain resolved via GitHub API: tag 06e41f9 -> commit 2d5dd6b -> root a432b4a -> skills 633c776b..., byte-identical to the v0.6.0 baseline (bookkeeping, zero skills/ content change); plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.7.0. Local: both checkers OK, suites 5/5 and 8/8. Delivered in PR #104, CI run 34991060941: all three jobs green, run log shows 'federated pins OK (3)' and 'federated content OK (2)' against the new pin. Process defect recorded: the In Progress transition was written on another task's branch and discarded by a git reset --hard before this task's branch was cut, so PR #104 landed with status To Do and this close travels in its own PR, not because the evidence was post-merge.
